A stack-buffer-overflow in Mat_VarReadNextInfo5 (src/matio/src/mat5.c): while parsing MAT5 variable metadata the code reads values derived from a small stack-allocated buffer (uncomp_buf) and performs a 4-byte read past the end of that buffer. This out-of-bounds access can corrupt stack memory when processing malformed or malicious MAT files, leading to crashes or other memory-corruption impacts (e.g., information disclosure or potential code execution).
